primarySources.contract: The native Reflist implementation emits a headless default-group reference list and forwards the sole refs argument as its bank.
The native target selects the same default group and raw refs bank. Explicit nível=0 suppresses its own heading.

projection: Only one explicitly named nonempty refs argument, preserving the entire raw argument name, padding and value byte-for-byte. Replace the exact native Reflist header with Referências and append nível=0. Existing target calls remain completely raw. No group, entity, body, nested call, alias priority, blank or extra argument is normalized.
vetoes: Positional, empty, duplicate or additional arguments
Changed reference identity, group, body, metadata or order
limitations: This is a bounded native wrapper contract for logical reference identities. Uncertain entities and opaque note bodies remain ambiguous and unexpanded. It is not a whole-document HTML equivalence claim.
